name: mtg-data
description: Magic: The Gathering tournament data, from the scrape to a meta read you can audit. Four skills: mtg-tournament-analysis reads the format (meta share, win rates with a 95% range, matchup matrices, card-level signal), deck-check puts the right archetype name on every deck, vod-review reviews your own games and keeps a play profile, and rules-check quotes the current Comprehensive Rules. The scrapers run on your machine, and your play ledger never leaves it. Run scripts/setup_workspace.py once after install.
